notes: Fault scan: asks every module the car has, not only the ones in the open SVT, so no module is left out. Slow modules (for example the climate module) are read instead of showing "no answer", and a module that does not answer at all no longer holds the scan up for long. Modules the scan did not get to say so. Fault texts: newer wording for about 2,000 BMW fault codes. Code several: finishes as soon as E-Sys shows its report, and codes a module whose line was already selected. Faster: E-Sys no longer stops for a moment after Read FA or Read SVT; the launcher's Home no longer searches the disks every 15 seconds, and NCD compare reads big folders without freezing. A desktop E-Sys shortcut now starts that E-Sys even when the launcher is already open. Garage: car cards show the build date, paint, options and modules from the backups made when E-Sys reads the car. FDL editor: Re-apply my coding sets both bytes of a two-byte setting, and the value list only takes an option you click or confirm with Enter. Safer: writing a previewed vehicle order, battery registration, Insert signed NCD, fault clear, module restart and ignition check the car and E-Sys's connection once more right before they act. E-Sys still starts when an E-Sys MAX setting file is damaged.
